narrative.overview:
The portfolio is one business document that posts. It borrows the look of an SAP ALV grid: a cobalt header field, a pale sheet (#f2f4f7) ruled with 1px hard lines, dense numbered rows with column heads, tabular numerals, and two status lights (posted green, in-process amber). Every project is a numbered record in a tree (1, 1.1, 1.1.2), so a career reads as a connected system, not a card grid.

The page has exactly one tilted element, the green POSTED stamp, and exactly one clock: the six flow cells (Receive, Pick, Reconcile, Label, Pay, Support) post one by one, driven by scroll on wide windows (the scrollbar is the clock) and by a timer elsewhere. Everything else is axis-aligned, flat and ruled.

A Three.js layer extends the same world into depth without changing its vocabulary: a hero warehouse whose conveyor and gate lights follow the flow state, a rack of 20 crates in the profile, and a pallet that fills in the contact section. Green and amber appear only as status.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt field for the header band, hero and contact; sheet grey for everything between.
1px hard rules, 2px ink rules at table tops and group heads; square corners everywhere except the round status lights.
Depth numbering in Martian Mono down a single vertical axis (72px gutter, 44px on narrow screens).
Green and amber are status only. Ink #0b1624 is text and the heavy rules.
One stamp, one clock, one 3D layer tied to the same flow state.

rules.name: The Two Lights Rule
rules.body: Green means posted, amber means in process. Neither is ever used as decoration or as an accent on interactive controls.

rules.name: The One Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only chromatic brand color; tints are cobalt-tint or the lighter scene blues inside the 3D layer. No second hue enters the palette.

rules.name: The Ledger Numerals Rule
rules.body: Anything measured or numbered is tabular (tabular-nums); only keys and figures use Martian Mono.

rules.name: The Thai Opening Rule
rules.body: On the TH page body is 1.125rem at 1.7 line height, labels lose uppercase and letter-spacing, and headings open to 1.3 to 1.4 line height so Thai marks are not clipped.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat at rest and on hover; state is shown by color swap (white to ink, cobalt to white) or rule weight, never by shadow.

dos: Do keep every surface square with 1px rules (#c4ccd6) and use 2px ink rules for table tops, group heads and open edges.
Do keep status color to green (#17a05d) and amber (#f2b01e) and use them only for posted and in-process.
Do number new records on the depth axis and set keys and figures in Martian Mono with tabular numerals.
Do drive any new 3D element from `window.__flow` or section scroll so it stays tied to the one clock, and give it a reduced-motion still frame.
Do write each language on its own page, with technical terms and proper names kept in Latin inside Thai sentences.
donts: Don't add shadows, rounded cards, or a card grid; state is color swap or rule weight.
Don't add a second tilted element, a second stamp, or a second clock.
Don't introduce a hue beyond cobalt, green and amber, or use green and amber as decoration.
Don't show EN and TH text together in the same view.
Don't present the synthetic flow record as real client data; it keeps its demo tag.
